note: Wearables for the avatar. Items with `group` are cut from the MakeHuman base mesh's own helper shells; items with `mhclo` are MakeHuman assets (clothes, hair, brows, lashes) fitted to the shaped body and rigged exactly; items with `file` are external meshes under assets/garments, rigged by weight transfer. Add items by editing this file; the pipeline reads it and does not need changing.
licence: Every item must carry its own `licence`, and anything without one is refused. Cut items are MakeHuman CC0 1.0. External files must record a licence clear for commercial use.
source_note: `group` names a group inside the base mesh. `y_min` / `y_max` cut that shell by height in mesh units (the figure runs about -8.2 at the feet to 8.5 at the crown). `offset` lifts the garment off the skin along its normals so it does not z-fight. `mhclo` paths are relative to assets/. `colour` may be `from_photo` (hair) or `from_brows`; on a textured item it recolours the texture.

items.label: Short hair
items._why: Cut from the skull itself rather than the base mesh's helper-hair shell. That shell is a loose fitting volume for long hairstyles, not a haircut, and renders as a faceted dome over the face. A skull cap offset a few millimetres reads as short hair; a real haircut needs an authored mesh.

items.label: Hair underlayer (worn under a haircut)
items._why: The skull cap in a darker shade of the person's hair, worn under a hair mesh so no pale scalp shows between strands, as roots would.

items.label: Test vest (imported file)
items._why: Exercises the import path: a garment with its own topology, rigged by weight transfer. Generated by `python garments.py`.
